simple.summary: יָמַשׁ (yâmash) means to touch First listed occurrence: Judg 16 26.

definitions.full: H3237. yamash יָמַשׁ verb (si vera lectio) touch , Hiph`il Imperative suffix והימשׁני Kt (i.e. וְהֵימִשֵׁנִי ) Judg 16:26 ( יַהֲמִישֵׁנִי Qr) and let me touch (no doubt text error for הֲמִשֵּׁנִי from משׁשׁ , q. v.)
